name: Goblin Boss
_comment: SRD 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0), Goblin Boss. AC 17 comes from the gear (Chain Shirt 13 + Dex 2 + Shield 2); to-hit +4 and 1d6 + 2 damage from Dexterity, PB +2 and the weapons. Multiattack (two attacks, Scimitar or Shortbow in any mix) is effect.extra_attack; the extra 1d4 on an attack roll with Advantage is effect.monster.advantage_rider; Nimble Escape (Disengage half) is effect.monster.nimble_escape. Redirect Attack is deferred (nat20-table TASKS.md MON-7, P2). Darkvision, Hide and the senses are out of scope.
